item.title: ABC News: Three charged over alleged interference with a corpse
item.description: Two men and a woman are due to appear in court today after a man allegedly interfered with a corpse at a Logan funeral home.

item.title: ABC News: Aussie's heroic Paris Masters run ends at the hands of rising French star
item.description: After downing Novak Djokovic earlier in the week, Australia's Rinky Hijikata's heroic Paris Masters run finally comes to an end.

item.title: ABC News: 'No confidence' vote against Cornell leadership after alleged gang rape
item.description: The symbolic gesture reflects a deep discontent on the New York campus in the wake of a former student's lawsuit saying she was gang raped at a fraternity party in 2024.

item.title: ABC News: For third time, volunteers find missing person after police pause search
item.description: For the third time this year, it appears a person missing in Tasmania has been found not by police, but by a team of volunteers.

item.title: ABC News: Labor may need a clean slate to find a path back to power in Queensland
item.description: Queensland Opposition Leader Steven Miles faces a popular premier, frustration from Labor's right faction, and an insurgent One Nation in his path back to the top job, writes Alex Brewster.

item.title: ABC News: Megan Schutt on ADHD, medication and what's changed since her diagnosis
item.description: Like many women in their 30s and 40s, Australian bowler Megan Schutt has been diagnosed with ADHD later in life. The world champion sat down with ABC Sport to talk medication, mum guilt on tour and her decision to retire from ICC tournaments.

item.title: ABC News: Man dead and another injured in Melbourne CBD stabbing
item.description: Homicide detectives are seeking information and witnesses to a stabbing near Melbourne's Queen Victoria Market that left a man dead and another injured.

item.title: ABC News: Connecting community through sport celebrated at Indigenous Sports Awards
item.description: An autoimmune disease diagnosis when he was young inspired Noongar and Martujarra man Nat Heath to start TriMob, and it's being recognised at the National Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Sports Awards.

item.title: ABC News: Cooking classes help cut cost of living and boost social connection
item.description: A regional community centre's free weekly cooking class, using homegrown and donated ingredients, is teaching people to cook on a budget, while fostering connections.

item.title: ABC News: Anger over Tungkillo data centre should have Labor on red alert
item.description: With the Liberals, One Nation and the Greens all leaning into community fears about data centres, the Malinauskas government could be left holding the bag if it can't regulate them properly.

item.title: ABC News: Voters in Melbourne's south-east concerned by crime and community safety
item.description: In a seat held by Victoria's shadow minister for police, Brad Battin, residents are concerned by crime but also forging community connections.

item.title: ABC News: Reefs' new name echoes the legacy of the 'Bingil Bay Bastard'
item.description: John Büsst was a poet, artist, revered conservationist and friend of the prime minister, who campaigned for the Great Barrier Reef to be protected when many scientists hesitated to get political.

item.title: ABC News: Fine line between boxing and barbarism breached in 'frightening' KO
item.description: In the chaos following Nelson Asofa-Solomona's terrifying knockout of Paul Gallen, the sickening nature of his quadruple uppercut onslaught was overlooked.

item.title: ABC News: Endangered crayfish return home months after Victorian bushfires
item.description: An endangered species is returning home months after bushfires destroyed its habitat.

item.title: ABC News: Breaking: Trump to replace chief of staff with hardline deputy Stephen Miller
item.description: In a social media post, US President Donald Trump says his chief of staff will leave her post on Monday, less than a week after his Republican Party's disastrous midterm election performance.
